title: Lightspeed targets $250M for new India fund, focusing on early-stage AI | TechCrunch
summary: Starting with the new fund, Lightspeed is also moving its India funds onto the same fundraising cycle as its global funds for the first time, per the investor letter. The total included a $980 million early-stage venture fund.
